notes.subject: El hashamayim
notes.rationale: אל השמים: 'El min ye sankolow ɲɛ' (construct) — 'sinkolow-El' walima 'sankolo-El', misalen caman bɛ yen

notes.subject: sankolow ɲɛ
notes.rationale: Bamanankan tɛ construct cogo di, kun ɲɔgɔn-sira de ka kan ka bisa

notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: חסד bɛ to a yɛrɛ la sariya-matarafali kɔrɔ; bayɛlɛmali dɔgɔnw tɛ se ka a ta cogo kelen na

notes.subject: jama
notes.rationale: הודו imperatif pluriel — kuma in bɛ jama di k'a fɔ aw ye

notes.subject: sankolo-El
notes.rationale: Tɔgɔ in 'El min aw sankolow ɲɛ' — Tanaki kɔnɔ a bɛ kɛ tuma dɔw (Ezra, Neh, Ps) — PS 136:26 bɛ a fɔ

translation: Aw ni sango El min aw sankolow ɲɛ, sabu a ka hesed bɛ ta kɔlɔkɔ.
